# Shared comparison fixtures

These fixtures retain deliberately synthetic original RNA reports, including
invented energies and declared recognized software identities. They do not
import ViennaRNA, start a producer driver, or establish native deployment.
Preparation reserves an original local identity without starting it. The actual
practical handoff reader, original result acquisition and bounded grading worker,
Workflow child commission and typed form admission remain in use.

The comparison then uses the real selected-input authority, separate bounded
worker, immutable artifacts, deterministic calculation validation, exact requested
typed projection, scientific forwarding and practical completion estimator.
Only original producer status is supplied by a labeled test observation.
Scientific test horizons are caller fixtures; comparison completion uses the
ordinary practical endpoint. A missing original synthetic bundle is a real
acquisition failure, not evidence that a native experiment failed.

The two original descriptor operands come from distinct handoffs. The selected
routing anchor is the variant handoff, while WT is explicitly the baseline.
Pair data: WT -4 with `(((...)))` and A -5 kcal/mol with `((.....))`;
C to U at index 6, whose original partner 2 becomes unpaired.
Scan data additionally contain B -4, C -3, an authenticated acquisition failure,
declared not-tested and not-supplied members, and an explicit alias of A.

Existing 360 provider/schema adapters and scientific library setup are reused.
358 fixture helpers supply synthetic serialization and recorded producer-context
construction; 367 helpers supply explicitly invented numerical model inputs.
The original production fixture files and all older tests remain unchanged.
